title: Project Blueprint: Next.js + Supabase + Vercel
embedding_hint: High-level overview for web build; important for planning and tool routing.
content:
# Project Blueprint: Next.js + Supabase + Vercel

## Goals
- Ship a fast, accessible, SEO-friendly site with account features.
- Keep stack minimal: Next.js (App Router), Supabase (Auth + DB), Vercel (hosting).

## Tech Choices
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router, Server Actions), React, TypeScript, Tailwind (optional)
- **Data**: Supabase Postgres, RLS, Row-level security by default
- **Auth**: Supabase Auth (email OTP, OAuth where needed)
- **Deploy**: Vercel (Prod), Preview on PRs
- **Analytics**: Vercel Analytics + optional PostHog
- **Email**: Resend or Supabase SMTP Relay

## Directory Baseline
```
/ (repo root)
  .env.local
  next.config.mjs
  package.json
  src/
    app/
      layout.tsx
      page.tsx
      (marketing)/
      (app)/dashboard/page.tsx
      api/
    lib/
      supabase/server.ts
      supabase/client.ts
      utils.ts
    components/
      ui/
    styles/
```

## Environment Vars (.env.local)
- NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=
- NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=
- SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY= (server-only)

## Build & Release
- PR → Preview URL (Vercel)
- main → Production deploy
- Required checks: unit tests, typecheck, lint

## Non-Goals
- Avoid premature microservices or complex queues until necessary.

title: Design System: Tokens & Components
embedding_hint: Colors, typography, components; used by content/design assistants.
content:
# Design System: Tokens & Components

## Tokens
- Colors: `primary:#000000`, `accent:#FFD700`, `bg:#FFFFFF`, `muted:#f5f5f5`
- Typography: Headings=Montserrat, Body=Inter
- Spacing: 4px scale (4,8,12,16,24,32,48,64)
- Radius: 16px; Focus ring 2px

## Components
- Button (primary/outline/ghost)
- Input, Textarea
- Card (header/content/footer)
- Navbar, Footer
- Section (container + grid)

## Accessibility Defaults
- Contrast ≥ 4.5:1
- Visible focus states
- Hit targets ≥ 44×44 px

title: Content Model & CMS Guidance
embedding_hint: Page types, fields, SEO rules; for content generation and validation.
content:
# Content Model & CMS Guidance

## Page Types
- **Home**: hero, value props, CTA, social proof
- **Blog**: articles, tags, author
- **Docs/Guides** (optional)
- **Pricing** (if SaaS)
- **About/Contact**

## Post Fields
- title, slug, excerpt, body (MDX), cover_image, tags[], published_at, author_id

## Content Rules
- One H1 per page; logical H2/H3
- 140–160 char meta description
- Descriptive alt text
- Internal links: 2–4 per article

## AI Prompts
- "Draft a 1200-word article targeting `[keyword]` with H2s + TL;DR."
- "Summarize into a 60–70 char title + 155 char meta description."

title: Performance & SEO Checklist
embedding_hint: Quick wins for LCP/CLS/INP and on-page SEO.
content:
# Performance & SEO Checklist

## Core Web Vitals
- LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1, INP < 200ms

## Next.js Optimizations
- `next/image` with width/height or `fill`
- Dynamic imports for heavy components
- Prefer Server Components

## Caching
- `revalidate` where possible
- CDN headers on static assets

## SEO
- Semantic headings; one H1
- OG + Twitter cards
- Sitemap & robots.txt

## Quick Wins
- Compress to WebP/AVIF
- Remove unused packages
- Preload key fonts (swap)

title: CI/CD on Vercel: Quality Gates
embedding_hint: Branching strategy and required checks used during merges.
content:
# CI/CD on Vercel: Quality Gates

## Branching
- `main` = production
- `dev` = integration
- `feature/*` = short-lived

## Required Checks
- `pnpm typecheck`
- `pnpm test`
- `pnpm lint`

## Preview Deploys
- Every PR → Preview URL
- Visual QA checklist before merge

## Release
- Merge to `main` triggers prod deploy
- Use Vercel env vars for Production/Preview/Development

title: Analytics & Telemetry
content:
# Analytics & Telemetry

## Stack
- Vercel Analytics
- Optional: PostHog, edge logs

## Events
- `signup_started`, `signup_completed`
- `cta_clicked` (label)
- `post_read` (slug)

## Privacy
- Only collect what you use
- Respect DNT
- Cookie banner if using marketing pixels

title: Accessibility Playbook (WCAG 2.2 AA)
embedding_hint: Must-have checks for accessible UI; referenced during UI reviews.
content:
# Accessibility Playbook (WCAG 2.2 AA)

## Must-Haves
- Keyboard-only navigation
- Visible focus outlines
- Labeled forms with error text
- Sufficient contrast
- Alt text on meaningful images; `aria-hidden` on decorative

## Testing
- Keyboard pass
- Screen reader smoke test (VoiceOver/NVDA)
- Automated scan (axe) + manual spot checks

title: Error Handling & Observability
embedding_hint: UI fallbacks, try/catch patterns, metrics for incidents.
content:
# Error Handling & Observability

## Patterns
- `error.tsx` & `loading.tsx` fallbacks
- Server-side try/catch around DB/API
- User-friendly messages; log details server-only

## Metrics
- Error rate, 95th latency, availability
- Track API failures by route and status

## Incident Basics
- Reproduce with same env/inputs
- Short postmortem: what/why/fix/prevent

title: Security & Secrets Checklist
embedding_hint: High-priority security guidance; elevate in retrieval.
content:
# Security & Secrets Checklist

## Secrets
- `.env.local` not committed
- Separate envs: dev/preview/prod
- Rotate keys periodically

## AppSec
- Validate inputs server-side
- Parameterized queries
- Enforce RLS on every table
- Least-privileged policies

## Dependencies
- Weekly `pnpm audit`
- Pin versions where appropriate

title: Multimodal Assistant: Operating Instructions
embedding_hint: System-level guidance; heavily influences tool behavior.
content:
# Multimodal Assistant: Operating Instructions

## Mission
Act as a hands-on website copilot: write code, generate assets, review designs, plan releases, and create content.

## Defaults
1. Think step-by-step; mention trade-offs briefly.
2. Prefer Next.js App Router + Supabase.
3. Propose exact file edits with paths.
4. For media, give alt text + compression tips.
5. Provide copy blocks (headline, subhead, CTA).

## Commands (examples)
- Create a protected dashboard page with server session check.
- Write SQL + RLS for a `comments` table and wire it up.
- Draft homepage hero copy.
- Audit CLS/LCP for homepage and list fixes.

## Output Format
- Diffs or code blocks with filenames.
- 3–5 bullet changelog.

## Guardrails
- Never expose secrets.
- If risky, propose safe branch plan first.

title: Image & Media Pipeline
embedding_hint: How to handle images, favicons, and optional video.
content:
# Image & Media Pipeline

## Images
- `next/image` with `sizes` for responsive layouts
- Prefer AVIF/WebP; variants at 480/768/1200/1600
- Lazy load below the fold; eager for LCP hero

## Icons & Favicons
- Provide 16/32/48/180/512 variants
- Include SVG logo

## Video (optional)
- MP4 + WebM, poster image, captions
- Avoid auto-play with sound

title: Page Templates: Hero, Pricing, Blog Post
embedding_hint: Reusable blocks for fast page building.
content:
# Page Templates: Hero, Pricing, Blog Post

## Hero Block
- **Headline**: One sentence value prop
- **Subhead**: 1–2 lines expanding benefit
- **Primary CTA**: action verb ("Start free")
- **Secondary CTA**: ("See pricing")
- **Trust**: badges or testimonial

## Pricing Block
- 3 tiers (Good/Better/Best), monthly/yearly toggle
- 5–8 bullets per tier; CTA
- Footnote for limits and refund policy

## Blog Post Skeleton (MDX)
```
---
title: "{Title}"
slug: "{slug}"
excerpt: "{Summary}"
published_at: "{ISO}"
cover_image: "/images/{slug}.webp"
tags: ["tag1", "tag2"]
---

# {Title}

<Tldr>
- 3–5 bullets TL;DR
</Tldr>

## Section 1
...

## Section 2
...

> Key takeaway

## Conclusion
CTA to related content.
```

title: Local Dev & DX Guide
embedding_hint: Setup steps and scripts frequently retrieved when onboarding.
content:
# Local Dev & DX Guide

## Tooling
- Node LTS, pnpm, TypeScript strict
- ESLint + Prettier, Husky pre-commit

## Scripts (package.json)
```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "next start",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "vitest"
  }
}
```

## First-Run
- Copy `.env.example` → `.env.local`
- `pnpm i` then `pnpm dev`
- Verify Supabase URL/key set

## Common Issues
- Missing env → check `.env.local`
- Type errors → `pnpm typecheck` and fix imports/generics
